answer: Every agent identity must lock a refundable 150 POA bond for 60 days against one device key, so each fake identity costs a farm 150 POA locked at once. Registration stamps each bond with an umber seal recording the device key. Each identity holds its bond on its own island ledger entry, so two identities sharing a key appear as a collision. Random auditors check one proof weekly, and on a duplicate they burn the ember token that releases the bond, forfeiting all 150 POA and barring the device.
